# FreeRTOS kernel

`Source/` contains FreeRTOS-Kernel V11.3.1 as ordinary repository files.

- Upstream: https://github.com/FreeRTOS/FreeRTOS-Kernel
- Commit: `3a22924e0a9ddbbc8b0758881c33b3422a5cc20d`
- License: [MIT](Source/LICENSE.md)

GitHub ZIP downloads include the kernel without a submodule checkout.
The upstream optional Community-Supported-Ports and Partner-Supported-Ports
submodules were not checked out and are not included; this project uses
the kernel's ARM_CM4F port.
